$comment: Publisher-to-target bindings and GitHub/hosting integrations (fm-a4b, plan: identity.map), per repository and per hosting target. Names only: no secret or variable values. `status` is verified (evidence: command or console path, with date) or needs-inspection (`missing` says what). A `check.workflow` entry is re-verified on every read-identity.mjs run (field `workflow.check` of identity `integration:<id>`); GitHub-side observations (secrets, variables, environments, hooks, runners, Pages, OIDC, installations) are values of the repository and organization identities in identity-values.jsonl. Cloudflare account facts were read through the operator's Cloudflare connector; re-reading them needs a Cloudflare API token with account read (wrangler on eris is not logged in). `rename` says what the organization rename does to the binding.
